text.p: Dutch biochemicals and food group Gist-Brocades NV said on Wednesday it expected net profit from ordinary operations in 1997 to show a clear rise.
"Barring major fluctuations on the currency markets, we expect the 1997 profit before extraordinary gains and charges to show a clear increase compared with 1996," the company said in a statement.
Earlier Gist-Brocades reported that net profit rose to 158.5 milllion guilders in 1996 from 144.1 million guilders in 1995.
Turnover grew to 2.02 billion guilders from 1.84 billion in 1995, exceeding the two billion guilder sales threshold for the first time in the company's history.
Gist-Brocades said turnover rose because of takeovers, cooperation pacts and organic growth. Sales rose strongest in Asia and Australia, it added.

The company will pay a 1996 dividend of 1.60 guilders, up 0.10 from 1995's 1.50. The shareholders can take up the dividend in cash or in new shares. Details of the optional stock dividend will be published on May 3.
